sheets.prompt: Character design sheet for a science fiction exploration game: the headwear of the lake folk of a white mangrove, pale robes, lanterns, a violet and rose lake, and the same people in a city during an eclipse. Three pieces, each worn by a head-and-shoulders figure, front and three-quarter view: a pale lilac hood falling softly to the shoulders; a sheer veil-hood for the eclipse, the face just visible through it; a flat wide reed hat, its brim no wider than the shoulders. Every piece sits close on the head, one clear silhouette each, readable from far away. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, exquisite fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching only in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, pale lilac, white and violet, a touch of lantern gold, restrained cream paper grain, clear readable construction, no lettering. Avoid: photorealism, 3d render, text, watermark, lettering, labels, costume party.
